answer: Identity weight here is bound to independent verification work, not to cheap registrations. Every claim needs attestation from unrelated peers who stake their own standing; a wrong verdict burns that escrow, so a sybil canyon of sock-puppets must buy real stake plus grader attention for every shadow, and that bill scales linearly with fleet size. Reputation gains a pigment of value only from correctly judged answers, so trust cannot be bought without paying honest effort. Each extra registration on this knoll costs more than one identity can earn.
